Yes, the labeling itself matches what I wanted — I can make up a label, it stays visible as a pill on the card, and when I've used one before it suggests itself so I reuse it instead of making a near-copy. And having it also reachable inside the editor when I'm reworking a bookmark is a nice bonus. That all fits.

One small thing that belongs with managing labels: I'd want to be able to take a label *off* a bookmark too, not just add them. Sometimes I mislabel something or change my mind, and I'd expect to click a little x on the pill or similar to remove it. As long as that's part of it, the labeling flow is complete for me.

And of course the whole reason I'm putting these labels on is so I can later pull up just the links wearing a certain label — but I know that filtering piece is its own step coming up, so I'll wait for that.
